title: HB 1283 (114th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 2, relative to elections.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec 1, new 2-4-108(e) (training only)
(quote) (e) The coordinator of elections shall include in the educational standards created pursuant to subsection (a) training on temporary forms of identification issued to non-United States citizens that may not be used as evidence of identification as set forth in
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Draft Sec 1: 2-2-134(c) records of purged voters kept 3 years instead of 2 (no ID or citizenship text).
(other) Draft Sec 2: effective on becoming law.
(other) Chaptered/HA0289 Sec 1: new 2-4-108(e) election-official training (above). Sec 2: effective 2026-01-01.
(other) version: 3105305-Draft (2025-02-06): caption bill; only 2-2-134(c) purge record retention 2 to 3 years. No slot a-e text.
(other) version: amend-244888-HA0289 (committee amendment 1, Crawford, 2025-04-02, adopted flag 0): deletes all after the enacting clause; substitutes the training rule in 2-4-108(e). Carries slot a text (training only).
(other) version: 3236810-Chaptered (2025-05-07, Public Chapter 394 = Senate Bill 1143, substituted for HB 1283): same as HA0289.
(other) note: Slot a text is a training duty for election officials, not a rule on what a voter must show: it refers back to 2-7-112(c) (existing law, unchanged here) and says temporary non-citizen IDs may not be used as voter ID. The House substituted SB 1143 on 2025-04-16; no House floor roll call is saved under HB 1283.
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
